global_exit_code_legend.2: usage or IO error: missing/extra positional, unreadable or malformed input file, a required flag left empty, or a flag.FlagSet parse error (unrecognized flag / bad value) — this last case applies uniformly to every subcommand that defines flags, on top of the per-command exit_codes below

commands.name: self-check

flags.name: transcript
flags.description: main session transcript JSONL path (model source: latest message.model wins over $ANTHROPIC_MODEL; also the identity-guard source when --session-id/--scratchpad-path is given)

flags.name: settings
flags.description: settings.json path (effortLevel fallback when $CLAUDE_EFFORT is unset)

flags.name: session-id
flags.description: identity guard: this session's own id (UUID) — verifies --transcript's trailing lines name THIS session, hard-abort on mismatch; mutually exclusive with --scratchpad-path; omit both to skip the guard entirely

flags.name: scratchpad-path
flags.description: identity guard: a path under this session's own scratchpad dir (session id parsed from it); mutually exclusive with --session-id; omit both to skip the guard entirely

commands.note: self-check surface: band and identity-guard enforcement are independent — --floor-*/--ceiling-* are always required; --session-id/--scratchpad-path are both optional but mutually exclusive with each other, opting into the identity guard only when either is set. Model resolution: transcript latest message.model, fallback $ANTHROPIC_MODEL. Effort: $CLAUDE_EFFORT, fallback settings.json effortLevel; an undetectable effort degrades to a model-only band check (never a hard error).

stdout.schema: bh.SelfCheckResult {model, effort, effort_detected, abort, warnings, reason, session_id_checked, session_id_match}

exit_codes.0: in band (and identity verified, or the guard was not requested)
exit_codes.1: abort:true — below the floor, and/or (when the identity guard is requested) a session-id mismatch
exit_codes.2: missing one of --floor-model/--floor-effort/--ceiling-model/--ceiling-effort; model undeterminable (transcript unreadable/model-less AND $ANTHROPIC_MODEL unset); with the identity guard requested: both/neither of --session-id/--scratchpad-path set, an unparseable/invalid session id or scratchpad path, --transcript missing, or --transcript unreadable/empty/all-malformed/naming no sessionId on any line
